properties.name: reflow2 places its cues on the agent's side of the interface too (its kit's hooks and its connect-time instructions), so they reach an agent that has not called reflow2 yet
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "We can keep (c) with (d) now, then (a)" (option c of the open question on cues)
properties.statement: reflow2 owns what a cue says, and places cues on the agent's side of the interface as well as in its replies: the hooks its kit installs (at session start, before a tool runs, at stop) and the instructions the server gives when an agent connects. A cue placed there reaches an agent that has not called reflow2 at all, which no cue inside a reply can.
